answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 28197 Country: India Title: I have some problem with friends.and relatives. now they disconnect to speak with me.but i want to speak and want to keep good relationship with them.but they can"t. so what is the way for this.and what and which dua i should recite?that thaey again come to me and speak well.kindly inform me as earliest, Question: assalamu alaikum. molana. i have some problem with friends.and relatives. now they disconnect to speak with me.but i want to speak and want to keep good relationship with them.but they can"t. so what is the way for this.and what and which dua i should recite?that thaey again come to me and speak well.kindly inform me as earliest,thank you Answer ID: 28197 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 66/67/B=1432) You should recite Ya Aziz (يا عزيز) 200 times after Isha salah with durood before and after while turning your face towards those relatives. Do it for 40 days. It shall soften their hearts. Further, sometime send them some gift and greet them when you meet them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
